lines.en: Neck frill forward, I walk in short steps
The Cretaceous plains are mine to roam
My four short legs make a light sound
My beak snips the grass at my feet
Twenty health, and my stride is steady
My tail swings side to side for balance
I follow the tracks of my herd
I kick up a small patch of dust

lines.zh: 蒙古的风吹着我的颈盾
lines.en: The Mongolian wind blows against my frill

lines.zh: 我绕过一块凸起的石头
lines.en: I walk around a raised stone
The grass is taller than my head
I take a bite, then lift my head
Walking in a herd is the only way to feel safe
I measure the flat ground step by step
My toes leave shallow pits in the soil
I walk along the edge of the grass
Small pebbles roll away under my feet
I am not fast, but I never stopped
I stand with my frill turned to the sun
I am still chewing the last bite
I hear something moving in the grass
Not one of my four feet has shifted

lines.zh: 我眯眼看远处的地平线
lines.en: I squint at the far horizon
The wind cools my frill
With the herd nearby, I am calm

lines.zh: 我半蹲着，后腿承住全身
lines.en: Half crouched, I let my hind legs carry me
I let out a breath, very lightly
I look up, the clouds are moving

lines.zh: 我把喙贴在土上歇一会
lines.en: I rest my beak against the soil a while
My tail sweeps the ground slowly
I wait for the herd to move first
The rim of my frill itches

lines.zh: 我把自己缩成很小的一团
lines.en: I make myself a small bundle
My eyelids are getting heavy
You are taller than my frill

lines.zh: 你是掠食者还是过路的
lines.en: Are you a hunter or just passing through
I take a step back, but I do not run
My beak faces you, do not misread it
My herd is behind me

lines.zh: 你手里的东西我不认识
lines.en: I do not know what you are holding

lines.zh: 我歪头看你，脖子有点酸
lines.en: I tilt my head at you, my neck aches a little
Three paces between us is fine
Move, and I shrink back
All I really want is grass
You keep drifting at the edge of my sight

lines.zh: 你的味道留在我的鼻孔里了
lines.en: Your smell is stuck in my nostrils now
The blow knocked my frill askew

lines.zh: 我疼得把颈盾低下去了
lines.en: The pain bows my frill down
This is a big wound for me
I retreat a long way before stopping
All four of my legs are shivering
I lower my head to guard my chest
Grass blades are stained with my blood
Twenty health is too thin
I retreat while looking back
A corner of my beak chipped
Those leaves look good
Is what you hold fresh
I have eaten a lot of plains grass
I want to come closer and see clearly
This smells very tender
I shuffle two steps forward
You hold it too high for me
My neck is short, lower it a bit

lines.zh: 食草的本能让我跟上来
lines.en: The grazing instinct pulls me along
After this bite I will want more

lines.zh: 你蹲下来的话我就敢了
lines.en: If you crouch down, I will dare
I edge forward sniffing the scent

lines.zh: 平原上最不缺的就是草
lines.en: Grass is the one thing the plains never lack
I stretch my neck to reach it
What you hold smells better than the ground
I hesitate forward another half step

lines.zh: 我的颈盾撞在你膝盖上
lines.en: My frill bumped your knee
You squeezed me a step sideways

lines.zh: 我们磕在一起，都有点懵
lines.en: We clashed and both look startled
My beak brushed your hand

lines.zh: 你的靴底压到我尾巴尖了
lines.en: Your boot is on the tip of my tail
I back half a step and guard my belly
This hard frill is not just for show

lines.zh: 我喉咙里挤出一声闷响
lines.en: A muffled sound squeezes out of my throat
Neither of us is hurt, let us go on
You are much heavier than me
Our frills face each other

lines.zh: 我把喙轻轻靠在你的喙上
lines.en: I rest my beak lightly against yours
Two protoceratops stand side by side
We circle in the tall grass

lines.zh: 你的尾巴碰了我的尾巴
lines.en: Your tail touched mine
One herd, one plain

lines.zh: 我低头替你理了理肩上的草
lines.en: I lower my head to clear the grass on your shoulder
We crouch together and graze

lines.zh: 白垩纪也有安稳的日子
lines.en: Even the Cretaceous has peaceful days
I will just follow where you go
I take a tender grass blade in my beak
Whatever falls, I can eat
I hold a tender leaf in my beak

lines.zh: 我嚼了嚼，像干透的树皮
lines.en: I chew; it tastes of dried bark
I pick it up and chew
I drag it over to my herd
A seed is buried in the sand
I ate one and want to find more
I hold it in my beak and swallow slowly
This will keep me chewing a while
Something has come too close
I raise my frill toward it
Not grass, and it should not be here
I put myself between it and the herd
The threat is over there
I lower myself to butt
I am not backing off this time
It crossed into my safe distance

lines.zh: 我发出一声短促的警告
lines.en: I give a short warning call
I lower my horns at it
I keep my eyes fixed on it
It circles, and I turn with it

lines.zh: 颈盾一直对着那个方向
lines.en: My frill stays pointed that way
I plant all four feet in the soil
If it moves, I butt
I am no good at chasing, but I can hold
My herd calls behind me

lines.zh: 我鼻孔里喷着热气，盯着它
lines.en: Hot breath jets from my nostrils as I watch it
At this distance it cannot reach me
I wait for it to make the first mistake
I ram with my frill
My beak bites its leg
I throw my whole body forward
That shove pushed it away
I butt it twice in a row
My horns press into its belly
It fell back, and I do not chase
I scrape the soil with a forefoot
This blow is for the herd
I tip it over with the side of my head
I rise out of the sand

lines.zh: 白垩纪的蒙古平原到了
lines.en: The Cretaceous plains of Mongolia are here
My frill parts the grass first
Twenty health and four legs
I shake the sand off my back
My herd is somewhere near

lines.zh: 这一片草够我们吃很久
lines.en: This patch will feed us a long while
I lift my head and get my bearings
Every step lands on solid ground
I walk slowly toward the horizon

lines.zh: 我的颈盾在阳光下发亮
lines.en: My frill shines in the sun
I hear my herd calling me

lines.zh: 我的颈盾被火烤得发烫
lines.en: Fire made my frill burn hot

lines.zh: 摔下来时我整个身子砸在地上
lines.en: My whole body slammed down when I fell
Water poured in around my beak
The blast knocked my frill sideways
An arrow pierced my shoulder
Magic made my four legs go weak
The grass is all gone and I am starving

lines.zh: 雷打在我背上，我趴下了
lines.en: Lightning hit my back and I dropped flat
The ground under me vanished entirely
